column1: # VERIFY-F61-V9 placement rows: three Sonnet helper calls (lines L01-L04, L05-L08, L09-L11) asked only for clear words and the x of their letters on a ruler strip; the L09-L11 call listed no letter a at all, so its four a's (occasions, pas, parcyeux, tant) are interpolated by the verifier between the neighbouring letters. A one-letter word 'a' is kept with its x; the script decides whether it is a CA position.
